b2-36-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Money or Time?
b2-36-01.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks if the problem is money. It is not money; it is time.
b2-36-01.prompt: Correct Carlos with a balanced sentence.
cues: Say it is not a problem of money
Say it is a problem of time
b2-36-01.target: No es un problema de dinero, sino de tiempo.
b2-36-01.english: It is not a problem of money but of time.
b2-36-01.canDo: I can balance a sentence with *no… sino…*, *tanto… como…* and *ni… ni…*.

b2-36-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Sure Answer
b2-36-02.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks if the plan will work. You are completely sure.
b2-36-02.prompt: Answer Meg and show you are sure.
cues: Use a strong expression of certainty
b2-36-02.target: No cabe duda de que el plan funcionará.
b2-36-02.english: There is no doubt that the plan will work.
b2-36-02.canDo: I can say I am sure with *no cabe duda de que* and *no dudo que*.

b2-36-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Planning an Essay
b2-36-03.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks how you will organise your essay. You will speak about the price first and then about the advantages.
b2-36-03.prompt: Tell Carlos the order of your two points.
b2-36-03.target: En primer lugar, hablaré del precio; en segundo lugar, de las ventajas.
b2-36-03.english: First, I will talk about the price; second, about the advantages.
b2-36-03.canDo: I can move an essay forward with *llegados a este punto* and *en suma*.

b2-36-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Time in a Phrase
b2-36-04.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks you for a short metaphor about time.
b2-36-04.prompt: Give Meg a metaphor about time.
cues: Compare it with something without using como
b2-36-04.canDo: I can recognise and use a metaphor, a rhetorical question and repetition for emphasis.

b2-36-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Closing Line
b2-36-05.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks you for the last sentence of an essay about the rise in prices.
cues: Say that the rise in prices needs measures
b2-36-05.target: En suma, el aumento de los precios exige medidas.
b2-36-05.english: In short, the rise in prices calls for measures.
b2-36-05.canDo: I can choose the right register for the person I am writing to.

b2-36-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Was Borges?
b2-36-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks who Jorge Luis Borges was, after you both read a short text about him.
b2-36-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg who Borges was and when he died.
cues: Say what he was and where he was from
b2-36-consolidation.target: Jorge Luis Borges fue un escritor argentino; murió en 1986.
b2-36-consolidation.english: Jorge Luis Borges was an Argentine writer; he died in 1986.
b2-36-consolidation.canDo: I can read a short text about Jorge Luis Borges and his book El Aleph.
